compensating_input: Format version 1.1 (D-190, IR-NET-09). The truncated fixtures carry a per-rate compensating-input table standing for the drive their dropped presynaptic neurons supplied; the full brain drops nothing and carries none, so its results are unchanged by the format change. The SR-EXT-01 subcircuits carry none: they are SR-EXT-02 as written, and every compensated construction lives under data/calibration/ (D-189).
not_the_srext_subcircuit: SR-EXT-01 defines the MVP subcircuit by activity in a full-brain run, which needs W_syn calibrated first. Both files are provisional with respect to SR-EXT.
